from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-rnd0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u054/system/state/workspace/programs/task-f336329d.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = sorted({v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0}, key=lambda c: min(j for row in grid for j, v in enumerate(row) if v == c))
    pieces = []
    for color in colors:
        cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
        r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
        c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
        shape = [(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in cells]
        pieces.append((color, r1-r0+1, c1-c0+1, shape))
    out = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    r = c = 0
    for i, (color, ph, pw, shape) in enumerate(pieces):
        for dr, dc in shape:
            if r+dr < h and c+dc < w:
                out[r+dr][c+dc] = color
        if i + 1 < len(pieces):
            r += ph - 1
            c += pw - 1
    return out
'''
